summary.text: Kristie Hart is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kristie Hart was also a Republican candidate for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 11 in the November 2022 and November 2024 general elections.
